title: Termograph profile library index
description: The catalogue Termograph reads to populate Profiles > Community. Written by the publish pipeline; never edited by hand in a pull request.

signing_key_id.description: Identifies the key the bundles below were signed with, so a client can tell a key rotation from a tampered index.

id.description: Stable identifier for this profile across versions.

provider.description: Who authored the profile. Free text, and independent of the signature — the signature says who published it.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR with an optional PATCH. Compared numerically part by part, with a missing patch as 0, so 1.10 is newer than 1.9. Deliberately not strict semver: every bundle published when this was introduced was two-part, and requiring three would have invalidated the whole catalogue. Duplicated by necessity in `_VERSION_RE` (`src/termograph/profiles/bundle/versions.py`) in `Cognisn/termograph` — there is no shared artefact between the two repositories, so keep both patterns identical.

platforms.description: Human-readable platforms this profile targets, e.g. 'Nuix Workstation 7.x'.

slots.description: Which component slots the bundle fills. Termograph shows the operator which analyses they must still run for the slots that are absent.
